pages.title: Brewing with Cake
pages.text: Place an Awkward Potion in a brewing stand and a cake in the ingredient slot. Drink the finished potion yourself, or use it on one of your own tamed, ordinary maids.

pages.title: Sweetness
pages.text: Drinking restores full health at once. For 10 minutes, Sweetness grants 20% more attack damage and 2 extra blocks of attack reach. Another drink heals you again and resets the timer without doubling either bonus.

pages.title: A well-fed maid
pages.text: While Sweetness lasts, your maid keeps her Trust and her Hunger stays at 15 or higher. For every 30 seconds she spends active in the world, she also gains 1 favorability point.

pages.title: A familiar scent
pages.text: Another tamed maid without Sweetness may come within 5 blocks and say, “Wow, you smell so sweet!” Each maid who notices the scent can comment once every five minutes.
